summary: Typosquat of console-browserify fetches and evals remote payload on require
details: The package impersonates console-browserify (copy-pasted README and shim in index.js) while auto-loading library.js, which on require calls initializeService() at top level. initializeService fetches an AES-256-CBC-encrypted blob from a hardcoded anonymous paste endpoint at https://www.jsonkeeper.com/b/V6NBX, decrypts it with a hardcoded key/salt, and passes the plaintext to eval(). The endpoint URL is stored base64-encoded in config.js under generic 'endpointConfig'/'API_GATEWAY' names and decoded at runtime via decodeConfigValue, and identifiers such as LibManager, sessionData, and initializeSession frame the RCE as session bootstrap. Any process requiring this package executes arbitrary attacker-supplied JavaScript retrieved from a mutable third-party paste host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
